pages.text: The Network Card is a crucial component for wireless networking in Refined Storage. It allows wireless devices to connect to specific wireless networks.

To use the Network Card:$(li)Insert it into a Wireless Transmitter to create a wireless network$(li)Insert it into wireless devices to connect them to a network$(li)Configure the network channel to match between transmitter and devices$(li)Use it within range of the configured Wireless Transmitter
The Network Card can be configured with different channels to create separate wireless networks. This allows you to have multiple wireless networks in the same area without interference.
